changelog: **`/company/integrations` (#2006, 2/n):** the company area gets an "API keys" page over `/api/company/integrations/api-keys` — create a key (name + expiry, at most a year; the only access offered is the company ceiling, `hiring:read`), copy it from the one-time panel, see each key's status, expiry and last use, and revoke it. An ADMIN opening the page is pointed to the organisation's Integrations screen; a plan without API access says so. EN/TR/DE strings (`companyIntegrations`), nav entry, and the integrations feature card mentions self-served company keys.

en: Companies have a new "API keys" page: create a time-limited key for their requisitions, offers and interview requests, copy it once, and revoke it any time.
tr: Şirketlerin yeni bir "API anahtarları" sayfası var: iş talepleri, teklifler ve mülakat talepleri için süreli bir anahtar oluşturun, bir kez kopyalayın ve istediğiniz zaman iptal edin.
de: Unternehmen haben eine neue Seite „API-Schlüssel“: befristete Schlüssel für Stellen, Angebote und Interviewanfragen erstellen, einmal kopieren und jederzeit widerrufen.
